purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly ASOS weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) covering January through June 2013, intended to be joined to flight records on the shared origin code and observation hour.
usage: Join on origin_code and observation_timestamp_utc (or truncate to hour) to attach weather to flight events; all measures carry their unit as a name suffix (fahrenheit, percent, degrees, mph, inches, millibars, miles), and consumers must handle nulls in wind_direction_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph, and pressure_millibars rather than assume a reading exists every hour.
limitations: wind_gust_mph is missing 74.55% of the time and pressure_millibars is missing 11.50% of the time, so aggregates over these columns should account for substantial sparsity; the original year, month, and day integer columns were dropped in favor of the existing complete observation_timestamp_utc because this proposal format has no action to merge multiple source columns into one, which may not fully satisfy a need for a separate local calendar date distinct from the UTC instant.
